title: WhisperLive
one_liner: A real-time speech-to-text server and client ecosystem using OpenAI's Whisper with WebSocket streaming.
what_it_is: WhisperLive is a Python-based server application that exposes a WebSocket API for real-time audio transcription. It supports multiple inference backends (Faster-Whisper, TensorRT, OpenVINO) to optimize performance on different hardware. The project includes browser extensions (Chrome/Firefox) and Python clients that capture microphone or tab audio, preprocess it into 16kHz mono chunks, and stream it to the server for near-instant text output.
how_its_built: The core server is built in Python using `websockets` for communication and `pyaudio`/`numpy` for audio handling. It integrates with ASR engines like `faster-whisper`, `tensorrt_llm`, or `openvino`. Clients are implemented as JavaScript Browser Extensions using the Web Audio API and AudioWorklets for efficient client-side resampling and buffering before sending binary data over WebSockets.
how_to_apply: Deploy the server on a machine with GPU acceleration (NVIDIA for TensorRT, Intel for OpenVINO) or CPU (Faster-Whisper). Connect browser extensions to transcribe meetings, lectures, or media playback directly in the browser. Integrate the Python client into desktop applications requiring live captioning.
quickstart:
bash scripts/setup.sh
pip install whisper-live
python3 run_server.py --port 9090 --backend faster_whisper
features: Supports Faster-Whisper, TensorRT, and OpenVINO backends
Browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox with tab/mic capture
Voice Activity Detection (VAD) to reduce processing load
Multi-client support with configurable connection limits

sequenceDiagram

        B-->>S: Return Transcript Segment

    end
    C->>S: Close Connection
